Senses.Explanation: An etiquette-derived unit naming the body's whole round of turning and bowing through the day, the very place the records locate the working. Foyan Qingyuan reads the day's turning and bowing, the walking and talking, the spreading of the bedding and the porridge and rice, as all of it the mad mechanism, and asks which within it is the person of the Way; Dahui Zonggao, speaking for the departed Xianglin layman, says whoever knows that one's face has walked hand in hand with everyone all along through every turn and bow, speech and stillness; and Xueyan Zuqin rules the same round of postures, dressing, eating, sitting, and sleeping to be the great composure present at hand. Chushi Fanqi makes it his standing saying that speech and stillness and every turn and bow is each one bright and each one native; Wuyi Yuanlai asks his brothers whose sustaining strength the day's turns and bows finally rest on; Feiyin Tongrong works it into verse — no gate above to push open, how many turns and bows, casually felling the coral tree, the scenery beyond the pattern arrives on purpose; Tianran Hanshi holds at the mid-autumn meeting that in turning and bowing there is no dodging it; and Miyun Yuanwu tells those past the barrier that every turn and bow through the twelve double-hours is none other than the home ground.
